cards.card_text: Proverbs starts a new section here, and the writer talks right to the listener: "Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise…" Then he adds, "…apply your mind to my knowledge…" Friend, that's the oldest way I know of saying PUT THE PHONE DOWN.
cards.verse_text: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise—apply your mind to my knowledge—
